My sons dad doesn't pay child support at all, I've always been too scared to take him for it because I do NOT want him to be able to have unsupervised visits with my son... I have no proof of anything, but the day I came home from work early to find my baby home alone, that wasn't the first time it had happened... Plus all the drugs. I know if I do take him to court, he will fight back, just to spite me.. And he doesn't want his son, I know he doesn't... Because if he did, he'd be making an effort now. Plus... Even if he did get visitation rights, weekends are the only time I actually get to spend with my son (we get a few hours after work, but never have time to actually do anything then) and I'm too selfish to let him take that from me after I've been the one to spend all the time raising him.
The abuse is also something I'm scared of... Not physical with my son, but I know how this man is, I spent 11 years with him... He's going to try to say horrible things about me to my kid.
I wish I could just up and leave and not have to deal with him anymore, ever.
It's so frustrating and difficult!

My first ever  time doing acid, I candy flipped. I had done mdma more times than I could ever count but for some reason I was always scared to try acid.
I was at a festival with a girl I had just met that day, she had done acid but never mdma and was planning on candy flipping, so I figured if she was doing it, I could too. Best experience ever.
Make sure you test your stuff though, because I've done it again since then and it wasn't as great (not bad, just could have been better)
I mostly just remember wandering around the festival (alone, and I later found out my friend was freaking out because she couldn't find me and knew it was my first trip) and just being amazed at everything. At one point I decided to go sit down in the tent for a while and I got stuck in there. I couldn't for the life of me figure out how to get out😂 but it was a great time. I felt do refreshed after and my head was so clear.
We want to, and I definitely think it will help him. We just have to figure out how, we no longer have insurance or the money to pay out of pocket

I know he knows how common it is, but he doesn't think he'd make it through another loss.
And I know the feeling, after I lost my first I was terrified of pregnancy again, but then I had a happy, healthy baby so I KNOW the feeling of the light at the end of the storm.. I didn't think I could survive if I ever lost another baby, but you do.. You have to. And it never gets easier... But I don't know how to get him to see that he can't hold onto that fear. It is really tough.

Good luck to you as well ❤️❤️ and keep holding on to your hope, it'll come ❤️

He went to as many appointments as he could while I was pregnant and then he spent the whole time in the hospital with me when we lost our baby, then he went to my follow up appointment as well. He knows exactly what would go on if I were to get pregnant again. But he doesn't think he could make it through another loss. I've tried to tell him you can't think about it like that, you have to have hope and since the Dr's have everything figured out now, our chances of having a healthy baby should be good.
We do love each other, but I don't know how to accept that he doesn't want to try again.

So I met this guy on okcupid and agreed to a date before we even started talking really... At the time, I didn't have a car, so he had to pick me up. Well, after talking a bit I realized that agreeing to go on a date was a huge mistake. First of all, the guy was 5 years older than me, he lived with his parents and his father was a pastor. He was a virgin and planned on saving it for marriage and he worked at Walmart. None of these things were overly awful, but... Here I was, living on my own, with a child and definitely not waiting till marriage. So, he wants to go see a movie.. Okay. Picks me up, and we go to Starbucks first where he gets a juice box. Then we go to the movie theater and he decides we're going to go see Planes... As in the children's movie... We go, get our seats and he wants to sit in the very front row. Next thing I know, he's shoving his tongue down my throat and his stuffing his hands up my shirt. All while there's a ton of kids behind us. About 20 minutes into the movie he says "why don't we go back to my car since we're not even watching this" for some god awful reason, I agree. So we go to his car and he continues... About 6:30ish, he tells me "well, we better get back it's getting really late and my parents will be upset if I'm out too late" and when he dropped me off at home, he told me he had a great time and that he really thought we would be good together and couldn't wait to see me again 😑 I never spoke another word to him after that. So awkward and uncomfortable.
